text:
sara_ml: heads-up, HF->Redwood conversion for neox-v2 produced unexpected special token id drift, model generates truncated replies sometimes. anyone seen this? @ajay_infra
ajay_infra: can you paste the tokenizer files you pushed (added_tokens.json, tokenizer.json, config.json snippet) and a tiny repro? quick guess: added_tokens appended without explicit ids or vocab_size not updated.
sara_ml: pasted below (shortened):
```
# added_tokens.json
[
  "<bos>",
  "<eos>",
  "<pad>"
]

# config.json (relevant)
{"vocab_size":50257, "bos_token_id":1, "eos_token_id":2}

# repro
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('models/neox-converted')
print('special map', t.special_tokens_map)
print('added', t.get_added_vocab())
print('<bos> id', t.convert_tokens_to_ids('<bos>'))
```
Output shows added tokens get ids at end of vocab (50257+) but config.json claims bos/eos are small ids -> mismatch.
mira_eng: yep that mismatch is the root. HF saved special token ids as small reserved ints in config but the tokenizer had added_tokens appended at save time so indices diverged. Redwood loader sometimes trusts config.bos_token_id and rewrites mapping which then doesn't match the embedding matrix ordering.
ops_ben: two common fail modes we hit: 1) not calling tokenizer.add_special_tokens(...) before saving, 2) letting save_vocabulary/save_pretrained write inconsistent files across envs (tokenizer.json vs added_tokens.json missing ids).
ajay_infra: practical fixes we use: call tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'bos_token':'<bos>','eos_token':'<eos>','pad_token':'<pad>'}) then save; ensure tokenizer.vocab_size equals len(vocab)+len(added_tokens); or write explicit ids in added_tokens.json. conversion tool should fail if config.bos_token_id >= vocab_size.
sara_ml: i made a local patch that writes explicit ids for added tokens and bumps vocab_size. example patch I applied:
```
{
  "added_tokens": [
    {"content":"<bos>", "id":50257},
    {"content":"<eos>", "id":50258},
    {"content":"<pad>", "id":50259}
  ],
  "vocab_size": 50260
}
```
after that redwood converter accepted without remap warnings and int8 quant run passed QA.
mira_eng: also watch conversions between SentencePiece and huggingface tokenizers: sometimes order changes and special tokens are moved to reserved slots (0-3) by some loaders. our conversion tool will now detect unusual placements and warn.
ajay_infra: add these to the checklist for new model onboarding: 1) save tokenizer after add_special_tokens; 2) assert special ids within [0, vocab_size-1]; 3) run a fresh python process to load tokenizer and assert convert_tokens_to_ids matches expected values; 4) CI test that loads the serialized tokenizer in a clean env.
ops_ben: i created a tiny unit test in model-registry that loads each newly registered tokenizer and asserts special-token id stability. CI passed on this run.
ci-bot: build 6103: onboarding-checks 1 passed (special-token-id-stability)
sara_ml: thanks! i'll update the model-ops playbook + models/README with the remediation steps and the minimal repro script. happy to share the patch if useful. :raised_hands:
